name: 明快平面-新扁平
type: Bold geometric Chinese sans-serif headlines, crisp simple body text, flat pictograms; strong hierarchy without ornamental fonts.

Flat fills, 0-6 logical px corners, crisp alignment, mostly borderless modules separated by whitespace. Absolutely NO shadows, NO gradients, NO translucent panels, NO 3D surfaces, NO black chunky outlines. Friendly geometric pictograms rather than rendered hardware. Design with type and color-area proportion.
